title: An Explainable System for Offensive Content Detection in Nastaliq Urdu: Corpus Curation, Transformer Benchmarking, and Word-Level Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2610.15795v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated moderation systems are deployed at scale, yet they remain opaque to the users and moderators affected by their decisions, and their coverage is almost entirely confined to English. For Urdu written in the Nastaliq script, no such system exists, and the annotated resources it would be built on are drawn largely from Twitter/X, where character limits constrain how users write. Interpretability has received little attention, leaving it unclear what such models actually learn. This study addresses these gaps in three steps. First, we curate and publicly release a corpus of 7604 Nastaliq Urdu Facebook comments, extending an earlier corpus by correcting text-level inconsistencies and re-examining the original labels. Second, we fine-tune four Urdu-capable transformers under a common grid-search protocol and compare them against twelve feature-classifier baselines on identical data partitions. translated_title: 面向纳斯塔利格体乌尔都语冒犯性内容检测的可解释系统：语料库构建、Transformer基准测试与词级归因
translated_abstract: 自动化内容审核系统已大规模部署，但对于受其决策影响的用户和审核人员而言，这些系统仍然是不透明的，且其覆盖范围几乎完全局限于英语。对于以纳斯塔利格体书写的乌尔都语而言，目前尚不存在此类系统，而构建此类系统所依赖的标注资源大多来自Twitter/X平台，在那里字符限制制约着用户的表达方式。可解释性很少受到关注，导致此类模型究竟学到了什么仍不清楚。本研究分三个步骤填补这些空白。首先，我们构建并公开发布了一个包含7604条纳斯塔利格乌尔都语Facebook评论的语料库，通过修正文本层面的不一致并重新审查原始标签，对先前的语料库进行了扩展。其次，我们在统一的网格搜索协议下微调了四个支持乌尔都语的Transformer模型，并在完全相同的数据划分上与十二种特征-分类器基线方法进行比较。表现最佳的配置是多语言Re（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究构建并公开了包含7604条评论的纳斯塔利格乌尔都语Facebook冒犯性内容语料库，通过基准测试多个乌尔都语Transformer模型与特征基线，并引入词级归因，首次为该语言提供了可解释的冒犯性内容检测系统。
en_tdlr: The study curates and publicly releases a corpus of 7604 Nastaliq Urdu Facebook comments, benchmarks Urdu-capable transformers against feature-classifier baselines, and delivers the first explainable offensive content detection system for Nastaliq Urdu with word-level attribution.
